graph.name: Eclorvalle AWS IoT SaaS Architecture
graph.notes: Eclorvalle provides a SaaS IoT platform that operates directly within the client's AWS account. User authentication is handled via Amazon Cognito SDK. Devices connect via MQTT through gateways to AWS IoT Core. IoT Rules Engine routes data to DynamoDB for storage and triggers Lambda functions for notifications (SNS), monitoring (CloudWatch), and storage (S3). All customer data remains within the customer's own AWS account, with deployment orchestrated via IAM.
